title: The Real Fuel Cost of Every Pickup in 2027 (One Costs 4x More Than Another)
description:
The official EPA fuel economy of every light-duty pickup on sale heading into 2027, turned into a yearly fuel bill at 2026 gas prices: small, midsize and full-size trucks, hybrids, the Duramax diesel, V8s, performance trucks and the electric Cybertruck. Every number comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:23 Gas prices in 2026
4:13 The small trucks
6:08 The midsize trucks
8:34 The full-size trucks
13:20 The diesel twist
15:19 The thirstiest trucks
17:40 The electric option
18:48 What it means for buyers
20:36 The verdict
